Roth.index_unique_le_log_div✝.{u_1} {σ : Type u_1} [Fintype σ] [Unique σ] {B : ℝ} {q r : σ → ℕ} (hq : 1 < q default)
  {R : MvPolynomial σ ℤ} (hR : R ≠ 0) (hRB : |↑((uniqueAlgEquiv ℤ σ) R).leadingCoeff| ≤ B) {h : σ → ℤ}
  (hh : IsCoprime (h default) ↑(q default)) :
  Roth.index ((map (Int.castRingHom ℝ)) R) (fun j ↦ ↑(h j) / ↑(q j)) r ≤
    Real.log B / (↑(r default) * Real.log ↑(q default))

private theorem Roth.index_unique_le_log_div.{u_1} : ∀ {σ : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype σ] [inst_1 : Unique σ] {B : ℝ}
  {q r : σ → ℕ},
  1 < q default →
    ∀ {R : MvPolynomial σ ℤ},
      R ≠ 0 →
        |↑((uniqueAlgEquiv ℤ σ) R).leadingCoeff| ≤ B →
          ∀ {h : σ → ℤ},
            IsCoprime (h default) ↑(q default) →
              Roth.index ((map (Int.castRingHom ℝ)) R) (fun j ↦ ↑(h j) / ↑(q j)) r ≤
                Real.log B / (↑(r default) * Real.log ↑(q default)) :=
fun {σ} [Fintype σ] [Unique σ] {B} {q r} hq {R} hR hRB {h} hh ↦
  let R1 := (uniqueAlgEquiv ℤ σ) R;
  have hmapeq :=
    id
      (Polynomial.ext fun n ↦
        Eq.mpr
          (id
            (congrArg (fun _a ↦ _a = (Polynomial.map (Int.castRingHom ℝ) ((uniqueAlgEquiv ℤ σ) R)).coeff n)
              (coeff_uniqueAlgEquiv ℝ ((map (Int.castRingHom ℝ)) R) n)))
          (Eq.mpr
            (id
              (congrArg (fun _a ↦ ((map (Int.castRingHom ℝ)) R).coeff (Finsupp.single default n) = _a)
                (Polynomial.coeff_map (Int.castRingHom ℝ) n)))
            (Eq.mpr
              (id
                (congrArg
                  (fun _a ↦ ((map (Int.castRingHom ℝ)) R).coeff (Finsupp.single default n) = (Int.castRingHom ℝ) _a)
                  (coeff_uniqueAlgEquiv ℤ R n)))
              (Eq.mpr
                (id
                  (congrArg (fun _a ↦ _a = (Int.castRingHom ℝ) (R.coeff (Finsupp.single default n)))
                    (coeff_map (Int.castRingHom ℝ) R (Finsupp.single default n))))
                (Eq.refl ((Int.castRingHom ℝ) (R.coeff (Finsupp.single default n))))))));
  have hmult :=
    Eq.mpr
      (id
        (congrArg
          (fun _a ↦
            Polynomial.rootMultiplicity (↑(h default) / ↑(q default)) (Polynomial.map (Int.castRingHom ℝ) R1) = _a)
          (Polynomial.eq_rootMultiplicity_map Rat.cast_injective (↑(h default) / ↑(q default)))))
      (Eq.mpr
        (id
          (congrArg
            (fun _a ↦
              Polynomial.rootMultiplicity (↑(h default) / ↑(q default)) (Polynomial.map (Int.castRingHom ℝ) R1) =
                Polynomial.rootMultiplicity ((Rat.castHom ℝ) (↑(h default) / ↑(q default))) _a)
            (Polynomial.map_map (Int.castRingHom ℚ) (Rat.castHom ℝ) R1)))
        ((fun {R} [Ring R] a a_1 e_a ↦
            Eq.rec (motive := fun a_2 e_a ↦
              ∀ (p p_1 : Polynomial R), p = p_1 → Polynomial.rootMultiplicity a p = Polynomial.rootMultiplicity a_2 p_1)
              (fun p p_1 e_p ↦ e_p ▸ Eq.refl (Polynomial.rootMultiplicity a p)) e_a)
          (↑(h default) / ↑(q default)) ((Rat.castHom ℝ) (↑(h default) / ↑(q default)))
          (of_eq_true
            (Eq.trans
              (congrArg (Eq (↑(h default) / ↑(q default)))
                (Eq.trans (map_div₀ (Rat.castHom ℝ) ↑(h default) ↑(q default))
                  (congr (congrArg HDiv.hDiv (map_intCast (Rat.castHom ℝ) (h default)))
                    (map_natCast (Rat.castHom ℝ) (q default)))))
              (eq_self (↑(h default) / ↑(q default)))))
          (Polynomial.map (Int.castRingHom ℝ) R1) (Polynomial.map ((Rat.castHom ℝ).comp (Int.castRingHom ℚ)) R1)
          (Eq.refl (Polynomial.map (Int.castRingHom ℝ) R1))));
  Eq.mpr
    (id
      (congrArg (fun _a ↦ _a ≤ Real.log B / (↑(r default) * Real.log ↑(q default)))
        (Roth.index_unique
          ((map_ne_zero_iff (map (Int.castRingHom ℝ)) (map_injective (Int.castRingHom ℝ) Int.cast_injective)).mpr hR)
          (fun j ↦ ↑(h j) / ↑(q j)) r)))
    (Eq.mpr
      (id
        (congrArg
          (fun _a ↦
            ↑(Polynomial.rootMultiplicity (↑(h default) / ↑(q default)) _a) / ↑(r default) ≤
              Real.log B / (↑(r default) * Real.log ↑(q default)))
          hmapeq))
      (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a ↦ ↑_a / ↑(r default) ≤ Real.log B / (↑(r default) * Real.log ↑(q default))) hmult))
        (have hlog :=
          Real.log_le_log
            (pow_pos
              (Nat.cast_pos'.mpr
                (lt_trans
                  (Mathlib.Meta.Positivity.pos_of_isNat (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.isNat_ofNat ℕ (Eq.refl 1))
                    (Eq.refl (Nat.ble 1 1)))
                  hq))
              (Polynomial.rootMultiplicity (↑(h default) / ↑(q default)) (Polynomial.map (Int.castRingHom ℚ) R1)))
            (Roth.pow_rootMultiplicity_le
              ((map_ne_zero_iff (uniqueAlgEquiv ℤ σ) (AlgEquiv.injective (uniqueAlgEquiv ℤ σ))).mpr hR)
              (Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hq) hh hRB);
        Eq.mpr (id ge_iff_le._simp_1)
          (Eq.mp
            (congrArg
              (LE.le
